name: 新 HSK 五级（3.0）

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.prompt: 请根据下面四张图，写一篇不少于100字的作文。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-40 (new HSK 5 picture story, at least 100 characters; count every character incl. punctuation):
36-40 = tells a coherent story that follows all four pictures in order, with a clear beginning, development and ending; varied HSK 5-level vocabulary and grammar used correctly; almost no errors
28-35 = follows the pictures and is coherent; some minor errors; length about right
20-27 = covers most pictures but thin or loosely connected; several errors
10-19 = misses pictures or much of the story, or many errors that sometimes block meaning, or well under 80 characters
1-9 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.prompt: 请写一篇不少于200字的作文。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-60 (new HSK 5 topic essay, at least 200 characters; count every character incl. punctuation):
54-60 = fully answers the prompt with a clear structure (opening, developed example or argument, conclusion); varied, precise HSK 5-level vocabulary and grammar; almost no errors; 200+ characters
42-53 = answers the prompt, coherent and organised; some minor errors
30-41 = on topic but thin, repetitive or loosely organised; several errors that rarely block meaning
15-29 = only partly on topic, or many errors that sometimes block meaning, or well under 160 characters
1-14 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).
